prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1500; do not mention it.)
text:
I am writing to advise that this office now represents the injured party in connection with the collision that occurred in the recent incident described in your file. The collision involved a low-speed head-on impact, and our client sustained injuries that are currently under medical evaluation. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, in writing, or in person.

We request that you provide a written statement of the liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, along with any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. We also ask that you confirm the claim number assigned to this matter so that our records can be aligned with yours.

Please ensure that all evidence relating to the collision is preserved. This includes photographs, vehicle data, repair estimates, recorded statements, telematics information, and any correspondence or internal notes concerning the incident. Please treat this letter as formal notice of the obligation to retain these materials until this matter is fully resolved.
